result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): A has one clear idea: a drill line dropping through the ground to water. It shows the mark in one flat color, reversed on dark and redrawn heavier at small sizes, all in a restrained green, cream and blue palette. Its wordmark is set too tight, so HARROW CREEK nearly runs together. B is a busy illustrated badge with many colors, a derrick that reads more like an oil rig, a rule that strikes through its tagline, and no true small-size or single-color version. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): B is built on one clear idea, a drill line going down through the ground to water. It shows the logo in one color, reversed on dark, and at true small sizes, all with a restrained green palette. Its weak spot is the very tight lettering, where 'HARROW CREEK' crowds together. A is a charming illustrated badge, but it uses many colors, its derrick reads more like oil than water, the tagline is struck through by its rules, and its simplified versions are never shown at a truly small size.
